feat(post): grblHAL post processor and generic 3-axis machine

Registers grblhal.cps as the "grblHAL" built-in post and
grblhal-3axis.mch as the "grblHAL 3-axis" library machine. Conformance
goldens under golden/nc/grblhal/ plus synth_grblhal.nc; tapping is
refused there by name. A new grblhal_post suite pins the program shape,
the lone T M6 after the Z lift, dwell seconds, the tap refusal, safe Z
stated/unstated and inch output. The cross-post tests (comment escape,
control and wear comp, tilt, inverted axis, after-op, coolant, machine
library) now include grblHAL.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(post): grblHAL lifts Z in the work offset unless the machine homes

Without homing ($22=0) grblHAL takes its power-on position as machine
zero, so the G53 G0 Z0 lift before each tool change and at the end could
rapid down into the part. The post now writes G53 G0 Z<safe> only when
the machine file states safe_retract (the statement that it homes);
otherwise it lifts with G0 Z<h> in the work offset, h the section's
ClearancePlane or a higher Z the program already commanded, refused by
name when h is unknown or not above StockZTop. The generic grblHAL
machine no longer states safe_retract.

feat(post): Synthetos TinyG post processor and generic 3-axis machine

A new built-in post, "TinyG" (assets/posts/tinyg.cps), for Synthetos TinyG
controllers running the edge-next firmware, and a generic "TinyG 3-axis"
machine. Specced from TinyG's public wiki (Gcode Support, Homing and
Limits, Flow Control and Footers, Inch and Millimeter Units Mode) and the
LinuxCNC G-code reference, behaviour only; structured after grblhal.cps.

- Header G21|G20 G17 G90 G91.1 G94 G64: the words M30 does not reset on
  TinyG. No %, O word, N numbers, G40, G49 or tool length word.
- Z lift (G53 only when the machine states safe_retract, else the work
  offset clearance, refused by name when unknown or buried), then
  `T<n> M6` alone and `M0` on its own line: TinyG's M6 moves nothing, so
  the stop is the operator's tool change. Tools 1-31; a larger number is
  refused by name.
- No canned cycles: drilling posts as its plain-move chain with `G4 P<s>`
  at the hole bottom; tapping, control/wear compensation, going home and
  tilted moves are refused by name; probing is refused by the engine.
- Comments drop the characters the serial input acts on (! ~ % / { $),
  lines are kept under 191 bytes, lengths are written at four decimals.

Every golden under golden/nc/tinyg/ and synth_tinyg.nc replays through the
edge-next firmware's own parser and planner (build 450.03) with no refused
line. Pinned by tinyg_post (11 tests), conformance, and the cross-post
suites after_op, comment_escape, control_comp, wear_comp, coolant,
coolant_followups, fanuc_post, inverted_post, machine and post/tests/comp.

Stacked on #715 (grblHAL post), which it extends the same lists as.

Fixes #836

fix(post): grblHAL names a smoothing ask it cannot bound

grblHAL's core lists G61 only - no G64 P or other tolerance word - so
with per-operation smoothing (#616) on, the post now writes one
"SMOOTHING NOT WRITTEN - GRBLHAL STATES NO SMOOTHING TOLERANCE" note
per program (as Fanuc and Mazak do) instead of dropping the ask
silently; the ask resets at each section end. Pinned by
smoothing::fanuc_and_mazak_name_the_ask_once_and_write_no_unbounded_word.
Also corrects the canned-cycle comment: G85 is listed but never mapped.

Refs #710
